# Builder Decade

> Field notes from a solo builder shipping real products with AI agents — software, hardware, and projects for the long game. No hype, no tutorial-farm noise. Bilingual English/中文.

## About
Builder Decade is published in English and Chinese (中文 at /zh/). Field notes from building real products with AI agents — the mechanics, the dead ends, and the costs.
